jobs.description:
SECURITY OFFICER - UNARMED
Job Locations
US-IL-Chicago
Category (Portal Searching)
Security Officer Level
Business Unit

OVERVIEW
Company Overview:
Allied Universal, North America's leading security and facility services company, offers rewarding careers that provide you a sense of purpose.
While working in a dynamic, welcoming, and collaborative workplace, you will be part of a team that contributes to a culture that positively impacts the communities and customers we serve.
JOB DESCRIPTION
This position is for Security officer for Northwestern Memorial Hospital Downtown Chicago!
Pay Range: $19.80 / hour - $23.30 / hour
$2 more an hour for working overnight shift!
PSO - Start at $19.80 / hour and receive an increase to $21.80 / hour upon completion of weapons detection training certification.
ED - Pay Rate: $21.30 / hour and increases to $23.30 / hour after receiving a certification in weapons detection training.
Candidates MUST be at least 21+ years of age
Candidates MUST be willing to have a yearly flu shot and certain vaccines up to date
Candidates MUST be able to wear required personal protective equipment on their face per CDC guidelines
Benefits include medical, dental, vision, 401k, and life insurance.
Apply today and join the world's largest security firm, Allied Universal!
Responsibilities:
Observe and remain vigilant for signs of crime, disorder, hazard, and unusual activity
* Patrol on foot, conditions, blocked entryways, security violations, mechanical problems, and unauthorized individuals
* Orally and physically de-escalating individuals, as needed
* Inspect all security devices and fire control equipment
* Screen members, visitors, and client employees to expedite their admittance to the facility
* Respond to incidents of fire, medical emergency, bomb threat, flooding, water discharge, elevator emergency, hazardous materials, or inclement weather with calm urgency
* May also include patient escort, patient watch, provide safety escort, assist and/or transport deceased to morgue
Minimum Requirements:
* Prior work experience involving dealing with customers, troubleshooting, and/or managing stressful situations
* Be at least 21 years of age
* Possess a high school diploma or equivalent
* As a condition of employment, applicants will be subject to a background investigation in accordance with all federal, state, and local laws.
Allied Universal will consider qualified applications with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable laws.
* As a condition of employment, applicants will be subject to a drug screen to the extent permitted by law.
* Licensing requirements are subject to state and/or local laws and regulations and may be required prior to employment.
*A valid driver's license will be required for driving positions only
* Post offer, must be able to successfully complete the training requirement and obtain a Management of Aggressive Behavior certification
Perks and Benefits:
* Health insurance and 401k plans for full-time positions
* Schedules that fit with your personal life goals
* Ongoing paid training programs and career growth opportunities
* Employee discounts through our perks program to your favorite restaurants, entertainment venues and much more...
CLOSING
Allied Universal is an
Equal Opportunity Employer.
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race/ethnicity, age, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, genetic information, disability, protected veteran status or relationship/association with a protected veteran, or any other basis or characteristic protected by law.
For more information: www.aus.com
If you have difficulty using the online system and require an alternate method to apply or require an accommodation, please contact our local Human Resources department.
To find an office near you, please visit: www.aus.com/offices.

jobs.title: Unarmed Security Officer Job at Unconquerable Security Solutions in Chicago
jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION
Job Description
Security Officer Duties & Requirements
The Security Officer is responsible for securing the premises, protecting personnel, and maintaining a safe environment by patrolling the property, monitoring surveillance equipment, inspecting buildings, equipment, and access points, and controlling entry onto the property.
Duties include responding to emergencies by sounding alarms and obtaining assistance, preventing loss or damage by reporting irregularities, informing violators of policies and procedures, and addressing trespassers when necessary.
The officer may also assist with traffic control by directing drivers and maintaining order in designated areas.
The Security Officer is expected to complete detailed reports by documenting observations, incidents, surveillance activity, witness statements, and required signatures.
Additional responsibilities include monitoring building systems and equipment controls, supporting preventive maintenance procedures, reporting equipment malfunctions, and assisting with improvements to security operations.
Candidates must be reliable, dependable, and able to conduct consistent patrols.
They must have a working understanding of mobile security patrol applications, communicate exceptionally well, and demonstrate a strong history of professionalism, accountability, and consistent work ethic.
Duties & Requirements
Must be able to patrol the property, monitor surveillance equipment, inspect buildings, equipment, and access points, and permit authorized entry.
Must respond appropriately to emergencies, sound alarms when necessary, and obtain assistance when needed.
Must prevent loss and damage by reporting irregularities, informing violators of policies and procedures, and addressing trespassers when appropriate.
Must assist with traffic control by directing drivers and maintaining order in designated areas.
Must complete detailed reports by documenting observations, incidents, occurrences, surveillance activity, witness information, and required signatures.
Must monitor building systems and equipment controls and report equipment malfunctions or repair needs.
Must be reliable, dependable, and have a strong history of consistent work ethic.
Must have an understanding of mobile security patrol applications.
Must communicate exceptionally well with supervisors, clients, residents, visitors, and team members.
Must have a thorough understanding of uniform policy and professional decorum.
Must remain neat, clean, and professionally presentable at all times while on duty.

jobs.title: Security Officer Full Time Unarmed Patrol Communications
jobs.description:
Allied Universal®, North America’s leading security and facility services company, offers rewarding careers that provide you a sense of purpose. While working in a dynamic, welcoming, and collaborative workplace, you will be part of a team that contributes to a culture that positively impacts the communities and customers we serve.



As a Security Officer Full Time Unarmed Patrol Communications in Chicago, IL, you will serve and safeguard clients in a range of industries such as Commercial Real Estate, and more. Join Allied Universal as an Unarmed Patrol Officer at a commercial real estate location, where you will monitor and patrol assigned areas, maintain a visible presence to help deter security-related incidents, support access control activities, and provide outstanding customer service. You will communicate professionally with tenants, visitors, and staff while contributing to a caring, agile, reliable, and innovative team that acts with integrity.

Position Type: Full Time

Pay Rate: $19.75 / Hour

Job Schedule:

DayTime
Mon11:00 PM - 07:00 AM
Tue11:00 PM - 07:00 AM
Wed11:00 PM - 07:00 AM
Sat07:00 AM - 03:00 PM
Sun11:00 PM - 07:00 AM

What You'll Do:

  • Provide customer service to tenants, visitors, vendors, and/or property staff by carrying out security-related procedures, site-specific policies, and when appropriate, emergency response activities.
  • Respond to incidents, access concerns, and critical situations in a calm, professional, problem-solving manner, escalating matters according to site procedures.
  • Conduct regular and random patrols of commercial property interiors, exterior areas, parking facilities, common areas, and perimeter locations to help deter unauthorized activity and identify security-related concerns.
  • Monitor access points and observe activity throughout the property, documenting incidents, patrol findings, and policy violations in accordance with site requirements.
  • Communicate professionally with building management, tenants, visitors, and emergency responders while supporting a welcoming environment at the location.

Minimum Requirements:

  • Have at least 5 years of security-related experience.
  • Customer service experience is preferred.
  • A Guard Card or license is preferred.
  • Be comfortable using a computer or tablet, preferred.
  • Access control and badge experience is preferred.
  • Be at least 18 years of age for unarmed roles; 21+ years of age for armed roles.
  • Possess a high school diploma or equivalent.
  • As a condition of employment, applicants will be subject to a background investigation in accordance with all federal, state, and local laws.
  • Allied Universal will consider qualified applications with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable laws.
  • As a condition of employment, applicants will be subject to a drug screen to the extent permitted by law.
  • Licensing requirements are subject to state and/or local laws and regulations and may be required prior to employment.
  • A valid driver’s license will be required for driving positions only.

Why Join Us:

  • Smart Tools: Access to our exclusive technology to view and claim additional shifts to earn more.
  • Career Growth: Get paid training and access to career growth opportunities.
  • Financial and Health Benefits: Enjoy access to a retirement savings plan, plus medical, dental, vision, basic life and AD&D, and disability insurance.
